Package io.foldright.cffu2

Class BaseCffu.TupleOps

java.lang.Object
io.foldright.cffu2.BaseCffu.TupleOps
Enclosing class:
BaseCffu<T,F extends BaseCffu<T,F>>
public final class BaseCffu.TupleOps extends Object
The tuple-based variants of methods from Cffu for processing multiple asynchronous actions in a type-safe manner.

While Cffu uses array-based methods with varargs, this class uses strongly-typed tuples containing 2 to 5 elements. The tuple approach provides better type safety when working with a fixed number of heterogeneous actions, as type mismatches are caught at compile time rather than runtime.

See Also:
  • CffuFactory.tupleOps()
  • CfTupleUtils
